''"Well, then you're under arrest too.|A Lanupa security cadet talking to Jod Na Nawood, KB and Neel|}} During the [[New Republic Era]], a '''human''' worked as a security cadet at [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]] on the [[planet]] of [[Lanupa]]. Around [[9 ABY]], they helped a [[Unidentified Lanupa security officer|security officer]] detain [[Jod Na Nawood]] for impersonating [[Professor]] [[Umiam Gorelox]]. ==Biography== They were a [[human]] security cadet at the [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]] on the [[planet]] of [[Lanupa]]. Around [[9 ABY]],{{SkeletonCrewDate}} after the [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] [[Jod Na Nawood]] and [[youngling]]s [[KB]], [[Neel]] ran away from a [[Unidentified Lanupa security officer|security officer]] who confronted Na Nawood for impersonating [[professor]] [[Umiam Gorelox]] the cadet was part of a group of guards who cornered Na Nawood on a walkway at the spa's [[Mud Pits]]. After telling the group that they were under arrest the youngling [[KB]] used a wrench to cause a mud pipe to spew mud at the group of guards causing them to fall into the mud pits. ==Personality and traits== They were a human with short [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s and tan skin. ==Equipment== While working at the spa, they wore a [[Color|green]] [[Clothing|uniform]] with a white [[helmet]], white [[belt]] and white [[glove]]s. ==Behind the scenes== The cadet appeared in ''[[You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates]]'', a ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'' episode that premiered on [[December 25]], [[2024]] and was portrayed by [[Bilal Sharmoug]]. ==Appearances== *{{SkeletonCrew|You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ლანუპას დაცვის უცნობი კადეტი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
